 WELCOME TO THE NEIGHBORHOOD

A little drive. A lovely day.

Hop in, then tap or click a spot on the ground. Your car follows the dotted route and parks there! Drag to look around.

Tap / click
Drive to that spot; Stop here cancels
WASD / arrows
Take over and point a direction. Release to stop.
E / action button
Stop, hop in or out, order food, take a bite
H / hello button
Honk in the car, wave on foot
Space
Jump on foot; extra brake in the car
B
Take a sandwich bite on foot
Drag / scroll
Look around / zoom

Drive through the glowing numbered gates in order. A bumped cone adds 2 seconds. Splash through the brown puddles, then head into the front of the purple car wash; it helps line you up. Hop out near the green café window to order a vegan breakfast sandwich. Friendly traffic will wait for you.

Badges and your best time last for this visit. Back to parking keeps your progress. Open menus pause the world.
